findings.label: Incomplete §0.3 disclosures in report.md
findings.detail: analyze.DISCLOSURES has 5 strings; §0.3 items 8 and 10 (Mac dev smoke) are not printed although §0.3 says all are printed in report.md. Print all ten items (e.g. embed the pinned protocol's §0.3 text).

findings.label: Missing report counts
findings.detail: §6.4 asks report.md for every near tie and the unmatched HuRI draw count; analyze.py scans near ties for cohort A only and never reports huri_manifest counts.unmatched_grade0_draws. Add both.

findings.label: Study-bias tertiles cohort A only
findings.detail: §4.5 n_PMID / STRING-degree tertiles ('cut points from the cohort's test anchors') are computed only for cohort A. Add Bclean or state A-only in the report. Descriptive.

findings.label: TOST 'not equivalent' boundary
findings.detail: tost_state uses >=/<= while §4.2 says 'entirely outside [−δ, +δ]'; use strict comparisons. Label text only, exact-boundary only.

findings.label: Gate-2 pass not enforced by train/score
findings.detail: train.py and score.py do not require a passing gate_reproduction*.json for the pins revision; ordering relies on the runbook (same as trials). Add a check.

findings.label: Silent φ exceptions
findings.detail: phi_array maps matcher exceptions to 0.0 (as epf); gate 2e's reference uses the same rule, so it cannot detect them. Count exceptions per file.

findings.label: Zero-shot Bclean rng fallback
findings.detail: With an incomplete cohort-B fold, Bclean/all_B zero-shot draws use default_rng([31415,2,0])/[31415,4,0] instead of the cohort's a* draws (§4.1). Descriptive only; disclose if it fires.
